title: Data Migrations: Create and Update Your Module's Data | Orchard Core
description:
A module that stores data needs that data to exist in every tenant, and to change as the module changes. Each tenant has its own data, so a change has to run once, in order, for each of them.

A data migration is a class of numbered steps that Orchard Core runs as a tenant starts. This video shows how to write one, register it, see one run, and what a step can do.

In this video:
• Why a module needs data migrations
• The migration class: CreateAsync, UpdateFrom steps and versions
• Registering a migration in a Startup class
• Watching a migration run when a feature is enabled
• Changing content definitions
• Creating and altering index tables
• Running a recipe from a migration
• Updating existing content
• Rules to keep when you change a migration
